g.text: Included WSI: 360. Original trial counts require all randomized patients, including those without images.
Age: two-sided Mann–Whitney test. Categorical variables: nominal Pearson test, missing excluded. Repeated category P values refer to one omnibus test.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a33122
